verdict.rationale: Increase is API-first: docs show that transfers, accounts, cards, entities, and holds are all created/managed via API, an OpenAPI spec and CLI exist, and 'every API and dashboard feature is available in Sandbox' suggests API parity in the sandbox. However the evidence doesn't explicitly confirm every dashboard-only feature (e.g., approval workflows, team management, dashboard-specific views) is fully API-accessible in production, nor is there independent corroboration of full UI/API parity. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that all production dashboard actions (not just sandbox) are API-exposed, and independent/hands-on verification of full parity.
